title: I Rebuilt the Chess Lesson Around the Decision
presenter_rule: Native HeyGen source at 1.0x. Presenter and product proof alternate at full frame; presenter-only scenes use eased wide-to-medium reframing for editorial energy, and no split-screen crop is permitted.
asset_rule: One continuous live gameplay progression. Do not loop screenshots, repeat a still as a new scene, or show two product assets at once.
music_rule: Authorized The Stream 2.0 stem remains audible below speech with mild ducking only.

scenes.visual: Presenter fills the chess environment with no competing product panel.
scenes.motion: Wide opening reframes to medium at 13.8 seconds with a 12-frame dissolve, then settles into a gentle close framing at 26.8 seconds; no hard cut or speed change.

scenes.visual: Presenter fills frame in the chess environment. Small Public browser pilot label only.
scenes.motion: Gentle close framing holds the claim boundary before dissolving to full-frame product proof; no competing asset.

scenes.visual: Live Explore capture: enter mode, play e4, hold on board, guidance, and notation.
scenes.motion: Native product motion with a subtle viewport crop that tracks the active state.

scenes.visual: The handoff state fills the frame with e4 and the complete product viewport visible.
scenes.motion: Full-frame product proof enters with a soft push; no presenter crop or overlapping asset.

scenes.visual: Start game, wait for the computer response, then track board, notation, guidance, and candidate moves.
scenes.motion: Native product response; guided crop moves once from board to notation.

scenes.visual: Explore, Carry, Respond fill the frame as three sequential states, never simultaneous cards.
scenes.motion: Each state replaces the previous one with a 10-frame masked slide.

scenes.visual: Return to the presenter at full frame for the spoken conclusion and CTA.
scenes.motion: Presenter returns in a gentle close framing, then eases to medium at 164.8 seconds before the final CTA card; native motion and voice timing remain unchanged.

scenes.visual: AmaduTown shield and subscribe CTA fill the frame after the spoken CTA lands.
scenes.motion: Soft fade from presenter to the final branded hold.
